summary: Apiary Residences is bringing a new level of luxury living to Belleview Station, combining thoughtfully designed homes, hospitality-inspired amenities, and seamless access to dining, retail, and transit. With strong early leasing momentum and a curated lifestyle that extends beyond the residence, the project is quickly becoming one of the most sought-after addresses in the Denver Tech Center.

title: Summit FC Draws 63,004, Sets WMSL Attendance Record at Empower Field
summary: Summit FC set a WMSL attendance record with 63,004 fans at Empower Field. Discover how this milestone boosts professional soccer in Denver.

title: From Office Suites to Loft Living: Inside Viewpoint 41's Transformation in Virginia Village
summary: Viewpoint 41 Lofts is a 41-unit apartment community in Denver's Virginia Village neighborhood, converted from a 1963 office building into modern studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom residences managed by Cornerstone. The property stands as an early example of the office-to-residential adaptive reuse trend now reshaping Denver's built environment, with a central location steps from the King Soopers at Colorado Boulevard and easy access to I-25.

title: 1245 E Colfax Avenue Listed for $12M as Entitled Development Site
address: 1245 E Colfax Avenue
summary: A fully entitled, 144-unit micro-apartment development at 1245 E Colfax Avenue is listed for $12 million after the site's previous owner defaulted and lender Lead Funding took over, completed entitlements, and is now seeking a developer-buyer for the shovel-ready mixed-use project in City Park West.

summary: The former office building at 2001 N York Street has been demolished and replaced with new residential construction across from City Park. The project is a compelling example of office-to-residential redevelopment happening outside Denver's downtown core, where smaller neighborhood offices can present strong cases for housing.

title: RK Industries Site in Central Park Moving Toward Multifamily Redevelopment
address: 3800 N Xanthia St
summary: After operating as a major industrial site since 1997, 3800 N Xanthia St is now positioned for redevelopment following demolition approvals and RK Industries’ relocation to Aurora.

title: Route 40 rises along East Colfax as construction goes vertical
address: 1040 E Colfax Avenue
summary: Construction at 1040 E Colfax Avenue has gone vertical as Route 40, a seven-story, 210-unit apartment development by Consolidated Investment Group, begins to take shape at the corner of Colfax and Corona. The project rises directly adjacent to The Vixen, a 344-unit building now in lease-up, and will sit steps from a new Colfax BRT station at Downing, reinforcing a growing residential cluster along one of Denver's most active redevelopment corridors.

title: Welton Street Cafe Wins $1M Judgment Against Contractor After Years-Long Buildout Nightmare
summary: Welton Street Cafe, a decades-old soul food institution in Denver's Five Points neighborhood, has been awarded a default judgment of more than $1 million against the design-build contractor accused of stalling, overbilling, and delivering defective work during the restaurant's relocation. The cafe reopened in late 2024 with a new contractor after a three-year ordeal that nearly destroyed the family business.

title: Denver Pavilions Is Looking for Its Next Life. Here's How to Be Part of It.
summary: The Denver Downtown Development Authority is issuing an open call for architects, designers, retail strategists, and hospitality leaders to help reimagine Denver Pavilions as a next-generation, 24-hour urban destination. The visioning process will feed directly into a ULI Advisory Services Panel visiting Denver April 13-17, which will produce formal recommendations for the property's redevelopment.

title: Byron Weiss, the Man Behind Rock Drill, Has Passed at 86
summary: Byron Weiss, the longtime owner of Denver's Rock Drill property in RiNo, passed away on March 17 at the age of 86. His decades-long commitment to the site and its redevelopment helped shape one of the most anticipated projects in the city's pipeline.

title: Raptor Civil Engineering Expands Services With Dedicated Land Surveying Division

The rebrand comes alongside new tenant announcements, a 6,000 square foot pedestrian-focused community space under construction, and a proposal for 105 duplexes on the east side of the property.

title: Denver Planning Board Backs 66-Month Lifeline for Stalled Housing Projects
summary: Denver's Planning Board has unanimously recommended extending the validity of approved site development plans from 30 months to 66 months, a move that would preserve roughly 22,600 housing units currently at risk of falling out of the city's construction pipeline. title: Denver Seeks Restaurant Operator for McNichols Civic Center Building
summary: Denver is advancing the McNichols Building redevelopment with a new RFP for a full service restaurant, a key piece of its long term Civic Center activation strategy.

title: milehimodern Brings an Architectural Masterpiece to Boulder

Designed with intentional materials and seamless indoor-outdoor living, the $8.3 million home captures a refined, design-forward approach to Colorado luxury living.

summary: Saunders Construction completed the final major concrete pour on the Fox Park World Trade Center Parking Garage this month. By combining a jar return system, local vendor partnerships, and organic products, the market is redefining how Denver residents shop while reducing packaging waste.
